question: Which of the following was Oxford Dictionary's Hindi Word of The Year 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Nari Shakti.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nari Shakti (women empowerment) **has been chosen as** the Hindi word of the year 2018 by Oxford Dictionaries.**
 
• The **announcement** was made during a session at the ongoing **Jaipur Literature Festival.**
 
• **The use of ''Nari Shakti''** increased in march **2018**.
 
• The discussion began around the** Indian government's Nari Shakti Puraskar (Women Power Award) given by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__** 

 
• The** 2019 Oxford Hindi word **of the year was** “Samvidhaan”** or Constitution.
 
• The panellists felt that in 2019, the Indian Constitution “gained renewed significance for the common man of India”** because of the Sabarimala issue, the abrogation of Article 370, and the Supreme Court’s judgment on the Ram Janmabhoomi-Babri.**
 
• Oxford Languages has chosen** ‘Aatmanirbharta’ or self-reliance** as its Hindi word of the year for **2020**.
 
• **Vax **is** 2021 Word of the Year by Oxford.**
